cards.name: Save for Office
cards.summary: Legacy id of the old File > Save for Microsoft Office... command, which saved the artwork as a PNG sized for pasting into Word, PowerPoint or Excel. 30.2.1 has no menu item or Keyboard Shortcuts entry for it (harvest), so the command appears to have been removed; the id was not executed.
use_for: recognising the old Save for Microsoft Office step in legacy actions or scripts and replacing it with File > Export > Export As... (PNG) or Export for Screens
avoid: new scripts: export a PNG with doc.exportFile(...) or Export for Screens instead of calling this id
slides that must scale sharply: export SVG through Export As rather than a flat PNG
cards.script_api: Harvested invoke: app.executeMenuCommand("Save for Office") (id from Defaults.kys, never executed on 30.2.1; with no menu item behind it, expect Error 1200 'BKey' or nothing). Object-model route for the same job (unverified): doc.exportFile(new File(path), ExportType.PNG24, new ExportOptionsPNG24()).

cards.name: Scribble3
cards.summary: Old shortcut-file id of the Tweak distortion from the former Filter > Distort menu, which moves a path's anchor points and control handles by random amounts for a jittery, hand-tweaked outline; it is not the hand-drawn Scribble fill. In Defaults.kys the run ZigZag2, Twirl Tool2, Scribble3, Roughen3, Punk2, Distort2 mirrors that submenu (Free Distort, Pucker & Bloat, Roughen, Tweak, Twist, Zig Zag) in reverse, which puts Scribble3 on Tweak, and the live Tweak effect still carries the id 'Live Scribble and Tweak' (ai_effect harvest). On 30.2.1 executeMenuCommand("Scribble3") raises Error 1200 'BKey'; Tweak lives on as Effect > Distort & Transform > Tweak.
use_for: mapping legacy actions, scripts or custom shortcut sets that call Scribble3 onto Effect > Distort & Transform > Tweak (then Object > Expand Appearance for the old permanent result)
avoid: any script: the id raises BKey on 30.2.1; use the Tweak effect id 'Live Scribble and Tweak' (ai_effect harvest) instead
hand-drawn scribble fills: that is Effect > Stylize > Scribble ('Live Scribble Fill'), a different effect
cards.script_api: None: app.executeMenuCommand("Scribble3") raises Error 1200 'BKey' on 30.2.1 (harvest audit 2026-10-04). Effect > Distort & Transform > Tweak runs as app.executeMenuCommand("Live Scribble and Tweak") (opens its dialog) or pageItem.applyEffect(xml) with LiveEffect 'Adobe Scribble and Tweak' (ai_effect harvest; XML parameters unverified).

review.changes: summary/use_for/avoid/script_api: remapped from Effect > Stylize > Scribble to Effect > Distort & Transform > Tweak; the id sits in the old Filter > Distort run of Defaults.kys exactly where Tweak falls (between Roughen3 and Twirl Tool2) and Tweak's live id is still 'Live Scribble and Tweak'

cards.name: setCropMarks
cards.summary: Most likely the executeMenuCommand id of Object > Artboards > Convert to Artboards (the name survives from the old Crop Marks / Crop Area command it replaced): it turns the selected rectangle(s) into artboards of the same size and position. Inferred: the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog alignment placed this id on Convert to Artboards by order but the harvest did not accept it, and in Defaults.kys setCropMarks and releaseCropMarks sit between the Graph ids and the Compound Path ids (noCompoundPath, compoundPath), the slot of the Artboards submenu in the reversed Object menu; not executed on 30.2.1.
cards.how: Select one or more rectangles drawn at the sizes you want, then run the command; each becomes an artboard. No dialog opens.
use_for: turning rectangles drawn at exact sizes into artboards for a multi-size social or print set
rebuilding artboards from page-frame rectangles in a PDF or legacy file
avoid: artboards of exact numeric size or preset formats: create them in the Artboards panel or with the Artboard tool
scripts that must not depend on an unconfirmed id: add artboards from coordinates with doc.artboards.add(rect) (unverified)
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("setCropMarks") (id from Defaults.kys, not confirmed by execution on 30.2.1). Object-model route (unverified): doc.artboards.add(item.geometricBounds) for each selected rectangle.

review.changes: summary: added the Defaults.kys position (between the Graph and Compound Path ids) as evidence; rest unchanged

cards.name: setGraphStyle
cards.summary: Most likely the executeMenuCommand id of Object > Graph > Type...: it opens the Graph Type dialog for the selected graph, where the chart type (column, stacked column, bar, stacked bar, line, area, scatter, pie, radar), value-axis position, style and options are set. Inferred: the harvest found that menu item with no id, and in Defaults.kys the run setIconDesign, setBarDesign, graphDesigns, editGraphData, setGraphStyle mirrors Graph > Marker, Column, Design, Data (ids the harvest pairs) and Type in reverse; the id was not executed on 30.2.1.
cards.how: Select a graph made with one of the Graph tools, run it, and pick a type button. Style adds a drop shadow, a legend across the top and the front/back order of rows and columns; Options set column and cluster width. The dropdown at the top switches to the Value Axis and Category Axis pages (tick values, tick marks, label prefix and suffix).
use_for: switching an infographic chart between bar, line, pie and other types without re-entering the data
adding a legend or axis tick settings to a native Illustrator graph
avoid: ungrouping the graph to restyle it before the data is final: an ungrouped graph is no longer an editable graph
charts that need live data or modern styling: build them in a data tool and place or paste the result
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("setGraphStyle") (id from Defaults.kys, not confirmed by execution; opens the Graph Type dialog). No object-model route: GraphItem in the API harvest has no graph-type member.

review.changes: summary: setGraphStyle is next to editGraphData but not graphDesigns; restated the Defaults.kys run that mirrors the Graph submenu; script_api: GraphItem has no graph-type member (API harvest)

cards.name: showAllWindows
cards.summary: The macOS application-menu command Show All (Illustrator > Show All), which unhides every application hidden with Hide Illustrator or Hide Others; in Defaults.kys it sits beside hideOthers and hideApp. The Windows build has no such item (not in the walked menu bar or the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog of 30.2.1), so on this install it does nothing useful. Not to be confused with Object > Show All (id showAll), which reveals hidden artwork.
use_for: reading or porting macOS shortcut sets and scripts that call showAllWindows
avoid: revealing hidden objects in a document: use Object > Show All (id showAll)
Windows: bring hidden windows back with the OS taskbar, not this id
cards.script_api: Harvested invoke: app.executeMenuCommand("showAllWindows") (from Defaults.kys, never executed; macOS-only, so expect no effect or Error 1200 'BKey' on Windows).

cards.name: snapPref
cards.summary: Most likely opens Edit > Preferences > Smart Guides...: the guide colour, which smart guides show (alignment guides, anchor/path labels, object highlighting, measurement labels, transform tools, construction guides with their angle set, spacing guides) and the snapping tolerance. Inferred: the harvest found that menu item with no id; in Defaults.kys snapPref sits in the run pluginPref, hyphenPref, snapPref, guidegridPref, unitundoPref, keyboardPref, selectionPref, preference that mirrors the Preferences submenu in reverse (preference and selectionPref are harvest-paired; Slices has no id in the run), and Illustrator.exe stores it between guidegridPref and slicePref; not executed on 30.2.1.
cards.how: Opens the Preferences dialog on the Smart Guides page. Switch individual guide types on or off, pick a colour that contrasts with the artwork, choose the Construction Guides angle set that suits isometric or angled drawing and set Snapping Tolerance in points. The feature itself is toggled with View > Smart Guides (Ctrl+U).
use_for: isometric or angled drawing: set the construction-guide angles
calming a cluttered workspace by switching off measurement labels or object highlighting
tightening the snapping tolerance for precise icon work
avoid: just turning smart guides on or off: use View > Smart Guides (Ctrl+U)
pixel-grid icon work where smart guides fight pixel snapping: switch them off and use Snap to Pixel / the pixel grid instead
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("snapPref") (id from Defaults.kys, not confirmed by execution; opens the Preferences dialog). Single settings can be read or written with app.preferences.getBooleanPreference / setBooleanPreference / setIntegerPreference and the matching preference key (keys unverified).

review.changes: how: removed the unharvested '30/60 degrees' example; summary: the kys run is not a perfect mirror (no Slices id), added the Illustrator.exe neighbours guidegridPref/slicePref from the harvest pool

cards.name: SWFPresets
cards.summary: Legacy id of Edit > SWF Presets..., the manager for Flash (SWF) export presets. The 30.2.1 Edit menu walk has Transparency Flattener, Print, Adobe PDF and Perspective Grid presets but no SWF Presets, and the id has no Keyboard Shortcuts entry, so the command appears to have been removed; the id was not executed.
use_for: recognising SWF Presets calls in old actions or scripts so they can be dropped or replaced with SVG or Export for Screens output
avoid: web animation: export SVG or assets with Export for Screens and animate them in After Effects or HTML
cards.script_api: Harvested invoke: app.executeMenuCommand("SWFPresets") (from Defaults.kys, never executed on 30.2.1; with no menu item behind it, expect Error 1200 'BKey' or nothing).

cards.name: TracingPresets
cards.summary: Legacy id of Edit > Tracing Presets..., the preset manager from the Live Trace era. 30.2.1 has no such Edit menu item (harvest) and the id has no Keyboard Shortcuts entry; tracing presets are now picked and managed in the Image Trace panel (Window > Image Trace). The id was not executed.
use_for: mapping legacy tracing-preset steps in old actions or scripts to the Image Trace panel's preset list
avoid: tracing in 30.2.1: use Object > Image Trace > Make or the Image Trace panel and choose the preset there
cards.script_api: Harvested invoke: app.executeMenuCommand("TracingPresets") (from Defaults.kys, never executed on 30.2.1; expect Error 1200 'BKey' or nothing). Object-model route for tracing with a preset (unverified): var t = placedItem.trace(); t.tracing.tracingOptions.loadFromPreset("<preset name>");

cards.name: Transform3
cards.summary: Old shortcut-file id for Object > Transform > Transform Each..., the dialog that scales, moves, rotates and reflects every selected object around its own reference point (with Random and Copy options). On 30.2.1 executeMenuCommand("Transform3") raises Error 1200 'BKey'; the live command runs as 'Transform v23'. The shortcut file still lists Alt+Shift+Ctrl+D for it.
use_for: updating legacy scripts and actions that call Transform3 so they call 'Transform v23'
avoid: any script: use app.executeMenuCommand("Transform v23"), or transform each item in a loop with the object model
cards.script_api: None: app.executeMenuCommand("Transform3") raises Error 1200 'BKey' on 30.2.1 (audit_menu_ids.py, 2026-10-04). Use app.executeMenuCommand("Transform v23") (opens Transform Each), or per item (unverified): item.resize(sx, sy), item.rotate(deg), item.translate(dx, dy).

cards.name: TrimMark2
cards.summary: Probably the old id of the crop-marks command from Illustrator's former Filter menu, which drew printer's trim marks around the selected object's bounds: in Defaults.kys it sits among other old Filter ids (AI Object Mosaic Plug-in3, Last Filter). 30.2.1 has no menu item paired with it and the id was not executed. Trim marks are now made with Object > Create Trim Marks (editable paths) or Effect > Crop Marks (live).
use_for: mapping old actions or scripts that call TrimMark2 to Object > Create Trim Marks or Effect > Crop Marks
avoid: print jobs: let print or PDF export add trim marks (Marks and Bleed) instead of drawing them into the artwork
new scripts: the id is unconfirmed; use the Effect > Crop Marks id 'Live Trim Marks' (ai_effect harvest)
cards.script_api: Harvested invoke: app.executeMenuCommand("TrimMark2") (from Defaults.kys, never executed on 30.2.1; old Filter ids from the same block such as ZigZag2 and Scribble3 raise Error 1200 'BKey'). Effect > Crop Marks runs as app.executeMenuCommand("Live Trim Marks") (ai_effect harvest).

cards.name: Twirl Tool2
cards.summary: Probably the old Filter-menu id of the twist distortion, which rotates a path's points more at the centre than at the edges to give a swirl: it sits in Defaults.kys between ZigZag2 and Scribble3 (old Filter ids that raise Error 1200 'BKey' on 30.2.1), and the live Twist effect's LiveEffect name is still 'Adobe Twirl'. 30.2.1 has no menu item paired with it and the id was not executed. The same distortion lives on as Effect > Distort & Transform > Twist.
use_for: mapping old actions or scripts that call this id to Effect > Distort & Transform > Twist
avoid: new scripts: the id is unconfirmed; use the Twist effect id 'Live Twist' (ai_effect harvest)
hand-shaped swirls on part of an object: use the Twirl tool instead of a whole-object twist
cards.script_api: Harvested invoke: app.executeMenuCommand("Twirl Tool2") (from Defaults.kys, never executed on 30.2.1; neighbouring old Filter ids raise Error 1200 'BKey'). Effect > Distort & Transform > Twist runs as app.executeMenuCommand("Live Twist") or pageItem.applyEffect(xml) with LiveEffect 'Adobe Twirl' (ai_effect harvest; XML parameters unverified).

cards.name: unitundoPref
cards.summary: Most likely opens Edit > Preferences > Units...: the measurement units for General (rulers and dimensions), Stroke, Type and East Asian Type, and whether objects are identified by Object Name or XML ID; the id's name comes from the older Units & Undo pane. Inferred: the harvest found the Units... menu item with no id; in Defaults.kys unitundoPref sits between guidegridPref and keyboardPref in the run of preference ids that mirrors the Preferences submenu in reverse, and Illustrator.exe stores it between keyboardPref and guidegridPref; not executed on 30.2.1.
cards.how: Opens the Preferences dialog on the Units page. Set General to pixels for screen work or millimetres / inches for print, and Stroke and Type to points or pixels. The current document's General unit can also be changed in File > Document Setup or by right-clicking a ruler.
use_for: switching the workspace between print units (mm, in) and screen units (px)
making stroke weights and type sizes read in px for UI and web assets
avoid: changing only the open document's units: use File > Document Setup or right-click the rulers
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("unitundoPref") (id from Defaults.kys, not confirmed by execution; opens the Preferences dialog). Object model (unverified): app.preferences.setIntegerPreference with the unit preference keys, which are not in the harvest.

review.changes: script_api: removed the preference key 'rulerType' (not in the harvest); summary: added the Illustrator.exe neighbours

cards.name: Welcome screen menu item
cards.summary: Legacy id of the old Help > Welcome Screen... command, which reopened the start screen (recent files, new-document presets, learning links). The 30.2.1 Help menu walk has no such item and the id has no Keyboard Shortcuts entry; the start screen is now the Home screen shown when no document is open. The id was not executed.
use_for: recognising the old command in legacy scripts or shortcut sets
avoid: getting back to the start screen in 30.2.1: close the open documents to reach the Home screen instead of calling this id
cards.script_api: Harvested invoke: app.executeMenuCommand("Welcome screen menu item") (from Defaults.kys, never executed on 30.2.1; expect Error 1200 'BKey' or nothing).

cards.name: ZigZag2
cards.summary: Old shortcut-file id for the Zig Zag distortion, which adds points along a path and pushes them alternately in and out to give zig-zag (corner points) or wavy (smooth points) edges. On 30.2.1 executeMenuCommand("ZigZag2") raises Error 1200 'BKey'; Zig Zag now lives as Effect > Distort & Transform > Zig Zag, invoked with another id.
use_for: mapping legacy actions or scripts that call ZigZag2 onto Effect > Distort & Transform > Zig Zag
avoid: any script: the id raises BKey on 30.2.1; use the Zig Zag effect id 'Live Zig Zag' (ai_effect harvest)
cards.script_api: None: app.executeMenuCommand("ZigZag2") raises Error 1200 'BKey' on 30.2.1 (harvest audit 2026-10-04). Effect > Distort & Transform > Zig Zag runs as app.executeMenuCommand("Live Zig Zag") (opens its dialog) or pageItem.applyEffect(xml) with LiveEffect 'Adobe Zigzag' (ai_effect harvest; XML parameters unverified).
